This confirms it. Commit `a7d580522` introduced this exact block of code without a null check on `myDataChoices`, and all subsequent commits (075f65a1b, fc2b7cc3b reformatting, etc.) preserved this omission until the fix in b0c5379f.

Let's double check whether `myDataChoices` could actually be null at this point in the method (to confirm this is a real bug, not a false positive), and verify no earlier/other commit is the true root cause.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: a7d580522c762178aadcef72f72ba46a34a5b798

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I used `git blame` on the fixed lines (just before the fix commit) to find which commit last touched the `if ((myDataChoices.size() > 0) && ...)` block that the fix wraps in a new `if (myDataChoices != null)` guard. Blame traced the block back through several commits (`075f65a1b`, a whitespace-reformat commit `fc2b7cc3b` that rewrote the whole file but preserved content) to the commit that first added this exact code.

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `a7d580522` ("Yuan Ho", 2011-11-02) added the new block:
```java
if(myDataChoices.size() > 0 && myDataChoices.get(0) instanceof DerivedDataChoice){
    ...
}
```
right after the `init(myDataChoices)` call in `DisplayControlImpl`'s init method, but — unlike other similar guards elsewhere in the same file (e.g. `(myDataChoices != null) && (myDataChoices.size() > 0)` found at several other locations in the same class) — it omitted the `myDataChoices != null` null-check before calling `.size()`. This is precisely the gap that commit `b0c5379f` later closes by wrapping the whole block in `if (myDataChoices != null) { ... }`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- Other call sites in the very same file consistently guard with `(myDataChoices != null) && (myDataChoices.size() > 0)`, showing that `myDataChoices` is known/expected to potentially be `null` in this class, making the omission in this new block an inconsistency/bug rather than intentional.
- `git blame` on the pre-fix revision shows the un-guarded `if ((myDataChoices.size() > 0) ...)` line attributed back to `a7d580522`, and the content has been carried forward unchanged (aside from an unrelated whitespace/comment tweak in `075f65a1b`) all the way to the parent of the fix commit.
- The fix commit's diff is a pure, minimal addition of the missing null check (`if (myDataChoices != null) { ... }`) around exactly the block introduced by `a7d580522`, with no other logic changes — strongly indicating this was the root cause.

I'm reasonably confident in this attribution; the only minor uncertainty is whether the intermediate commit `075f65a1b` (which reworked the inner `if` condition but kept the outer null-check omission) should also be considered, but since it did not introduce or remove the null-check issue, I attribute the bug to `a7d580522`.
